headline: OpenAI releases GPT 6.1 Sol with advanced capabilities at reduced cost
body: OpenAI has introduced GPT 6.1 Sol, a model delivering near-Astra level intelligence at approximately one-fifth the price of its predecessor. This release directly impacts healthcare AI economics by lowering the cost barrier for deploying advanced language models in clinical settings. For health systems evaluating vendor partnerships and internal AI initiatives, the improved price-to-performance ratio reshapes ROI calculations for clinical documentation, evidence synthesis, and care coordination workflows. The emergence of tiered pricing models (including ChatGPT Pro 500 variants) gives healthcare organizations more flexibility in matching model capabilities to specific use cases without overprovisioning compute resources.
